method: read-only source/diff/contract inspection; no modifications or tests
verified_boundaries: Only normal drive() calls _drive_normal_flows; restricted flows and once-report retain their existing entrypoints.
When required_settlements initially equals zero, first ordinary discovery still executes. When check_completed does not finish all local responsibility, ordinary driving continues.

Existing pending results are synchronously delivered before any new ordinary flow; clock/configuration exceptions retain existing routes, StateDbFailure remains fatal, and BaseException cancellation is not swallowed.

The early decision is advisory only: after returning, main loop calls _run_work_facts again, settles current local owners, and uses the original close-admission write transaction. New persistent work observed inside that transaction keeps admission and returns to discovery.

A new local responsibility registered during the added preliminary WorkFacts await is included by the main-loop _run_work_facts call immediately afterwards; if it arrives during the later ordinary fact read, real owner settlement remains before final transaction.
coverage_limit: New completion-round tests cover first discovery, staggered completion, running owners, report changes, close transaction competition and completed failure. They do not explicitly inject a new local owner during the added preliminary WorkFacts await or directly exercise EXIT_REPORT_ERROR/cancellation/restricted entry through this wrapper. Source review found existing paths preserved; no tests run in this review.
local_responsibility_assumption: As in existing close protocol, new in-process required work must be registered in CombinedLocalWork and settled by its actual owner. The patch does not authorize skipping registered local work or transaction recheck.
